HMLR_TP_UPDATED_20260713
The title-plan supplement was updated on 13 July 2026.
HMLR_TP_ENGLAND_WALES
The title-plan supplement applies to England and Wales.
HMLR_TP_OGL3
The publication is licensed under the Open Government Licence version 3.0 except where otherwise stated.
HMLR_TP_REGISTER_ELEMENT
A title plan is one of three elements of a registered title.
HMLR_TP_THREE_ELEMENTS
The other registered-title elements are the register and filed documents referred to by the register.
HMLR_TP_READ_WITH_REGISTER
A title plan must always be viewed together with the register.
HMLR_TP_OS_CURRENT_AT_REGISTRATION
HM Land Registry bases a title plan on the Ordnance Survey mapping current when the land was registered.
HMLR_TP_ADJOINING_VERSION_DIFFERENCE
Adjoining title plans can use different Ordnance Survey editions and show different site detail.
HMLR_TP_HISTORIC_COPIES
HM Land Registry retains historical title-plan editions, mostly in electronic form.
HMLR_TP_GRAPHIC_PURPOSE
The title plan graphically supports the property description in the register.
HMLR_TP_GENERAL_EXTENT_PURPOSE
The title plan identifies the general extent of land in a registered title.
HMLR_TP_OTHER_REFERENCES
A title plan may identify land affected by easements, covenants or removals from title.
HMLR_TP_FILED_PLAN_NAME
Title plans were previously known as filed plans.
HMLR_TP_GENERAL_UNLESS_DETERMINED
Title plans show general boundaries unless a boundary has been determined under section 60.
HMLR_TP_NO_FRANCHISE_PLAN
Relating franchises and lordship titles do not have title plans.
HMLR_TP_PROFIT_POSSIBLE_NO_PLAN
In some circumstances a profit a prendre in gross title may not have a title plan.
HMLR_TP_THREE_CATEGORIES
The main title-plan categories are vector, raster and drawer/canister.
HMLR_TP_NEW_VECTOR
All newly created title plans are produced as vector plans.
HMLR_TP_VECTOR_INTELLIGENT
A vector title plan is electronically created, stored and described as intelligent.
HMLR_TP_RASTER_SCANNED
A raster title plan is an electronically stored image of a former paper plan.
HMLR_TP_RASTER_NOT_INTELLIGENT
A raster title plan is not intelligent.
HMLR_TP_DRAWER_PAPER_ONLY
Drawer or canister title plans exist only on paper because they were too large to scan.
HMLR_TP_DRAWER_OLD_TITLES
Drawer or canister plans invariably belong to old registered titles.
HMLR_TP_DEEDS_BASIS
Each registered extent is planned from information in the original title deeds.
HMLR_TP_UNIQUE_TITLE_NUMBER
Each registered extent is allocated a unique title number.
HMLR_TP_NO_ROUTINE_SURVEY
HM Land Registry does not routinely survey when deed plans and Ordnance Survey detail are compatible.
HMLR_TP_PECKED_UNDEFINED
Undefined boundaries may be plotted using pecked lines.
HMLR_TP_SCALE_URBAN
The usual urban title-plan scale is 1:1250.
HMLR_TP_SCALE_RURAL
The usual rural title-plan scale is 1:2500.
HMLR_TP_SCALE_LARGE_RURAL
Large rural title plans may use 1:5000 or 1:10000 scales.
HMLR_TP_ENLARGEMENT
An enlargement may be added when a small part needs clearer depiction.
HMLR_TP_PAPER_B4
Most paper title plans were prepared on B4 paper.
HMLR_TP_VECTOR_SIZE_RANGE
Vector title plans can range from A4 to A0.
HMLR_TP_RED_EDGING
Registered land is usually shown by red edging.
HMLR_TP_EDGE_INSIDE_LINE
Red edging normally follows the inside of physical or plotted boundary lines.
HMLR_TP_EXCEPTION_OUTSIDE_OR_PINK
In exceptional cases edging may follow the outside or the land may be pink-tinted.
HMLR_TP_SMALL_AREA_METHOD
Special colouring methods may be used where normal edging is impractical for a very small area.
HMLR_TP_EXCLUDED_ISLAND
An excluded island is shown by green tinting or hatching with red edging and a register note.
HMLR_TP_PART_BUILDING_NOTE
Registration of only part of a building is explained in the register.
HMLR_TP_COMPLEX_FLOOR_SUPPLEMENT
Complex floor levels may be shown on a larger-scale supplementary plan.
HMLR_TP_REMOVED_LAND_GREEN
Land removed to another title is usually green-edged with the new title number or green-tinted.
HMLR_TP_FLOOR_POLICY_2014
HM Land Registry changed its leasehold floor-level title-plan policy in October 2014.
HMLR_TP_LEASE_BUILDING_OUTLINE
A tenant title plan may show only the Ordnance Survey building outline.
HMLR_TP_LEASE_OUTSIDE_AREAS
Lease areas outside the building, such as parking, continue to receive a suitable plan reference.
HMLR_TP_LEASE_READ_TOGETHER
A leasehold register and title plan must be read with the lease.
HMLR_TP_DIMENSIONS_FROM_DEEDS
Title-plan measurements are shown only when they came from plans in the title deeds.
HMLR_TP_DIMENSIONS_STILL_GENERAL
Dimensions do not change the title plan from showing a general boundary.
HMLR_TP_DIMENSION_FEATURE_CHANGE
A feature used as a measurement origin may disappear or change, making dimensions unreliable.
HMLR_TP_OLD_DIMENSIONS_NOT_ROUTINE
Dimensions from deed plans are no longer routinely reproduced.
HMLR_TP_IMPERIAL_NOT_WHOLESALE
Pre-1995 imperial measurements have not been converted wholesale.
